answer.rationale: Situation matches the rollback case almost exactly: a recent release, write-path p99 climbing (5x target), and heavy write load. memory_b1 shows rollback cleared a checkout error spike and finished without customer impact. Capacity, failover, circuit breakers, and read-replica routing don't address a regression introduced 2 hours ago. With only one intervention available, the release is the most likely cause and rollback is the fastest way to recover sustained availability without losing writes. Pulling memory_b1 to confirm the rollback procedure is safe and has been executed cleanly here before committing.
